searchText: Happy new year everyone, shorts question: What are the latest image tags to run a kurtosis devnet with devnet-4 specs (or where can I find them)? Found this overview: https://hackmd.io/CgPV419yTsytULQlO4m6Qw but I guess there are also images available for erigon etc., are there? Happy new year 🙂 You can use these images for devnet-4 specs: https://github.com/ethpandaops/mekong-devnets/blob/master/ansible/inventories/devnet-0/group_vars/all/images.yaml#L3
